Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the incident, Driver 1 was stopped in a queue of traffic on a Pasadena, Texas roadway when the
front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 told the responding officer that the vehicle had
slowed suddenly and that there was insufficient time to stop. Driver 2 acknowledged responsibility for the impact and
did not dispute the sequence of events. Two independent witnesses on the roadside described the collision in the
same way, and both said they saw Driver 1 and a Passenger seated in the vehicle before and after the impact. Scene
photographs show rear-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle that is consistent with the reported force of the collision, with
no obvious prior damage to the vehicle noted at the scene. Driver 1 reported dizziness and a headache and was later
evaluated for a possible concussion. Driver 1 is listed as an insured operator on the policy covering the vehicle. The
Passenger declined transport and did not report injury at the scene.
